concepts.gloss_en: Through charity one need not do any work (labor) — a benefit of tzedakah stated in LM2:4

members.form: אין צריכין לעשות שום מלאכה ועסק
members.note: same statement in the identical passage (LM2:4); the second merely extends 'work' to 'work and business/occupation' — same referent idea
